stable.title: PlayDeck 0.4.7
stable.summary:
• Steam downloads no longer freeze when you leave the app. Leaving the app during the Steam client's own self-update showed "Session paused - tap Resume when ready" and froze the download. Background downloads are now on by default, the client self-update counts as a download, and the session stays awake while Steam is still starting.
• Everything is PlayDeck's own hosting now. The in-app updater, desktop catalog, Proton seed, Turnip source and PR test-build workflows pointed at upstream DroidDeck repos (and a CI app token that doesn't exist in this fork). They all point at Nabeelshar/testrealise now; the updater reads its own catalog.
• Desktop rebranded. The KDE desktop's launcher logo, look-and-feel icon and Return-to-Gaming icon were Valve's Steam Deck marks — they are PlayDeck's P mark now (desktop-kde-r3). The Steam startup movie assembles the new PlayDeck mark instead of the old D + blue orb.
